name: io.github.tonyyang0504/zendesk-mcp
description: Zendesk (messaging): me, list_inbound, get_thread, send, reply. Every tool maps to a documented endp

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ZENDESK_EMAIL_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Agent email followed by /token, e.g. jdoe@example.com/token: API-token auth is Basic '{email_address}/token:{api_token}' (https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ZENDESK_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token from Admin Center > Apps and integrations > APIs > Zendesk API.
